appointment.summary_en: The court or pre-trial authority orders an examination where specialised knowledge is needed. The order identifies grounds, task, materials and expert; a pre-trial order also sets a deadline.

questions.summary_en: The order sets the task. The expert may decline an opinion outside their specialty or without sufficient material, and must report newly discovered relevant material beyond the assigned questions.

items_en: Expert identity, appointment basis and examination location
Assigned task, materials and examinations, including scientific and technical means

rights_duties.summary_en: The expert must attend when summoned and answer within their expertise. The appointing authority explains duties and liability for a false opinion. The opinion does not bind the authority; disagreement requires reasons.

appointment.summary_en: The court appoints an expert on request or of its own motion for questions requiring specialised knowledge; multiple experts may be appointed.

questions.summary_en: The appointment identifies the subject, task and materials. Parties may question the expert to clarify the opinion at the hearing.

items_en: Submit the opinion at least one week before the hearing
Present the opinion orally at the hearing; the reviewed provisions do not specify a complete written-report structure

rights_duties.summary_en: Disclose grounds for recusal. The court may release an expert lacking qualifications or unable to perform. At the hearing the court reminds the expert of liability for a false opinion.

esignature.law_en: eIDAS Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183; national implementing act not verified

timestamp.basis: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014, art. 41 (as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183)
timestamp.qualified_recognition: A qualified electronic time stamp enjoys the presumption of the accuracy of the date and time it indicates and of the integrity of the data to which they are bound; it is recognised as qualified in all Member States. National implementing rules not verified.

open_questions: Liability to verify: Наказателен кодекс, чл. 291 (false expert opinion) - exact wording and maximum penalty; any civil or disciplinary liability of listed experts.

Statute on experts to verify: Закон за съдебната власт provisions on вещи лица and the ordinance on registration, qualification and remuneration of court experts (Наредба № 2 от 29.06.2015 г.), including any declaration form.

Electronic signature: national act (expected: Закон за електронния документ и електронните удостоверителни услуги; terms квалифициран електронен подпис, квалифициран електронен времеви печат) not verified on an official source.
Standards: БИС national adoption of EN ISO/IEC 27037/27041/27042/27043 (expected designation БДС EN ISO/IEC ...) not verified.
A prescribed written expert declaration and the complete civil-report structure remain unverified; the hearing warning is not a signed statement of truth.
